name: confirm-pr-comment
description: Add a reaction emoji to the current GitHub event comment.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: GitHub token with permission to add reactions.

REPOSITORY.description: Repository in the format "owner/name". Used when comment-url is not provided.

COMMENT_URL.description: API URL of the comment to react to. Defaults to github.event.comment.url.

COMMENT_ID.description: Numeric comment ID. Used with repository when comment-url is not provided.

REACTION.description: Reaction to add. Supports GitHub values (+1, -1, laugh, confused, heart, hooray, rocket, eyes) and emoji aliases (👍, 👎, 😄, 😕, ❤️, 🎉, 🚀, 👀).

reaction-id.description: ID of the created (or existing) reaction.

comment-url.description: API URL of the comment that was reacted to.
